servinfo.title: Accessory Drive Belt Tensioner / Idler Pulley Inspection

ptxt.intxrefpoff: Accessory Drive Belt Tensioner / Idler Pulley Removal and Installation:K12D

servinfo.ptxt: Check the following points. If check result is not OK, replace accessory drive belt upper tensioner (1) and lower tensioner (2).

item.ptxt: Turn accessory drive belt upper tensioner, lower tensioner pulley (3) and check that each pulley rotates smoothly without any abnormal noise.
Check damage on accessory drive belt upper tensioner and lower tensioner.
